name: Penny
tagline: Handles your Amazon reorders, and asks first before anything new.
description: Works from your existing order history, so restocking what you already buy is a short request rather than a search session. Want an alternative to a usual item? It compares the options before you commit. Anything new to it is held until you approve it, and it picks the quickest shipping that costs nothing extra.
author: minivan99
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
